name: Student po obmenu
source:
Your first day in the new place is filled with excitement and anticipation of new adventures. However, even you couldn't have imagined what awaits you. Prepare for your life to be turned upside down when you meet a mysterious girl who seems to have emerged from your dreams.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2444230/]Steam[/url]]
